description:
You are writing a paper and need to organize your references. Create a new collection named 'Manuscript 2024' (exact name). Then, find these 4 specific papers in your library and add them to this collection:

1. Turing (1936) - 'On Computable Numbers...'
2. Shannon (1948) - 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication'
3. Vaswani et al. (2017) - 'Attention Is All You Need'
4. Silver et al. (2016) - 'Mastering the Game of Go...'

Finally, add the tag 'cited' (without quotes) to all 4 papers in this collection to track that you have used them. Be careful to select the correct papers, as your library may contain other works by the same authors (e.g., Turing 1950 vs 1936).
